name: Optery
description: Personal data removal service that finds and removes customers' personal information from data broker sites, ranked #1 most effective in a Consumer Reports study and a multi-year PCMag Editors' Choice winner; its affiliate program pays 30% commission for the first 12 months per referred customer, in cash, through PartnerStack.

evidence.summary: Optery's own affiliate program page (fetched first-hand) invites businesses, professional influencers and marketers with websites, newsletters or social channels to apply via PartnerStack, states payouts are in cash (not credits or gift cards), and says no website is required — social media promotion is accepted.

The page's FAQ states the commission plainly: '30% commission for the first 12 months of sales for each new customer you refer' across Monthly, Yearly, Personal, Family and Business plans (example given: $75 per list-price Ultimate yearly subscription), with commissions processed 35 days after each referred transaction and a 90-day tracking window per click.

VERIFIED UNCAPPED: the page's FAQ asks 'Is there a maximum amount of commission I can earn?' and answers 'No. Currently there is no maximum on the amount of commission you can earn.' — an explicit no-cap statement on the brand's own page, so commission_cap is recorded as uncapped.

The page states Optery is a Delaware C corporation headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, SOC 2 Type II compliant, ranked #1 most effective in a recent Consumer Reports study and PCMag Editors' Choice 2022-2025; it publishes no creator-count figure, so creator_saturation is honestly recorded as unknown.

opportunity.title: Optery Affiliate Program — 30% for 12 months via PartnerStack, verified uncapped

reasons.niche_fit: Pure consumer privacy/security software — a core technology niche for creator reviews and 'remove your data' content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own page explicitly recruits professional influencers and marketers with social channels and says no website is required.
reasons.compensation: 30% of every sale for a full 12 months per referred customer, paid in cash — a top-tier rate for this category, and verified uncapped.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through PartnerStack from the brand's own page with personalized support promised; no public program email is published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Public application open to businesses, influencers and marketers; approval required but being an Optery customer is explicitly not required.
reasons.credibility: Delaware C corporation, SOC 2 Type II, Consumer Reports #1 effectiveness ranking and four straight PCMag Editors' Choice awards.

evidence.summary: ExpressVPN's own affiliate FAQ (fetched first-hand) publishes its default commissions verbatim: 1-month subscription $13, 6-month $22, 12-month $36 (USD per subscription), CPA-only with no recurring commissions, a 90-day affiliate cookie, last-click attribution, a $50 minimum payout, payment by the 15th of each month via PayPal, Payoneer or wire transfer. Because pay is a flat bounty rather than a percentage, commission_rate is recorded as null and the flat amounts are documented here.

Ancaster's program profile, verified 22 Aug 2026 from ExpressVPN's own published material, records that new affiliates apply through the Impact network (the brand's Become an Affiliate route links to its Impact campaign page) and confirms the $13/$22/$36 flat CPA structure.

The FAQ names the operator as Express VPN International Ltd, Road Town, Tortola, British Virgin Islands, and publishes the accounts-payable email for payment matters. No fetched page states any earnings cap or creator-count figure, so commission_cap and creator_saturation are honestly recorded as unknown.

opportunity.title: ExpressVPN Affiliate Program — flat $13/$22/$36 CPA per subscription via Impact

reasons.niche_fit: A flagship consumer VPN — one of the most-reviewed products in the technology creator niche.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A long-running affiliate program with banners, videos and targeted landing pages supplied to promoters, though its FAQ is written for existing affiliates rather than creator recruitment.
reasons.compensation: Flat CPA of $13-$36 per subscription depending on plan length, published on the brand's own FAQ — solid per-sale pay, but no recurring component.
reasons.contact_access: A published accounts email on the brand's own FAQ plus application through Impact; no dedicated creator inbox is published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications run through the Impact network campaign page; approval is required and coupon sites are typically not accepted.
reasons.credibility: One of the largest and longest-established consumer VPN brands in the world.
